instructorNote: This inject tests surge procedures after the alert goes out. Watch for the Communications Supervisor to declare a surge, move tip calls to ext. 4450, staff the conference room with three call-takers and log in to the overflow console (WCCFSP 2 and 5), and start a rumor count for the PIO. The Undersheriff should accept the EOC activation and the call-taking staff, and start an off-duty callout to cover 911 until the night shift arrives at 18:00.
